svg.title: Benchmark changes against main: Tessera 3 slower · 17 faster
svg.desc: u32 · reverse · 1,000: Tessera +26.3% regression; u64 · reverse · 48: Tessera +18.8% regression; u64 · all equal · 48: Tessera −8.1% improvement; {u64,u32} · random · 48: Tessera −6.8% improvement; u64 · 99% sorted · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera +8.2% regression; {u64,u32} · all equal · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −50.1% improvement; {u64,u32} · reverse · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −48.4% improvement; u64 · sorted · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −47.8% improvement; u64 · reverse · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −47.5% improvement; u64 · all equal · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −41.9% improvement; {u64,u32} · sorted · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −37.3% improvement; u64 · 16 values · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −28.9% improvement; u64 · 1% far swaps · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −13.4% improvement; u128 · 8 wide keys · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −12.2% improvement; {u64,u32} · 16 values · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −11.7% improvement; u64 · two values · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −10.2% improvement; u64 · sorted + tail · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −8.6% improvement; rec128_u64 · sparse digits · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −8.1% improvement; {u64,u32} · sorted + tail · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −7.0% improvement; u64 · 4,096 values · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −7.0% improvement
